vitality: +10% starting maximum HP; heal HP gained
lifesteal: Heal 1% of attack damage; capped per attack cycle
barrier: Block one incoming hit per room
salvage: +3 coins per completed room; once per room
second_chance: Revive once at 25% maximum HP this run
multiple_shots: +1 consecutive attack per cycle; +30% total output

area: Widen the slash or cone by 15%
jump_attack: Every 5 seconds leap to the nearest enemy and strike harder
hard_slam: First hit each cycle sends a 20% damage wave behind its target

marked_prey: Charged hits mark targets; follow-up arrows gain 10% damage
explosive: Impact plus 45% splash once per cycle; replaces Arrow Split
arrow_split: After the final hit, split into 3 weaker arrows; replaces Explosive Arrows

pinning: Bolts briefly pin small enemies against nearby walls
repeater: Rapidly fire the magazine, then take a longer reload
ballista: One huge penetrating bolt with a slower reload

arcane_residue: Spell impacts leave a brief damaging patch
mana_echo: Every fourth cast repeats at reduced strength
spell_focus: Repeated hits on one target build up to 30% extra damage
perpetuum: Replace pulses with a continuous laser
meteor: Replace pulses with delayed falling meteors

serrated_head: Lodged spears cause a short bleed
skewer: Penetrate one more enemy on outward throws
returning_strike: Stronger return hits; reposition to sweep enemies
impaler: Spears lodge longer and pulse area damage before returning

lingering_disc: Linger longer near the end of outward flight
serrated_rhythm: Repeated disc hits build a capped damage bonus
orbiting_blades: Replace throws with blades circling the character
hunting_discs: Stay out longer, ricocheting between enemies before returning

extended_combo: Add one slash before the stronger finisher
riposte: After a dodge or guard, the next slash is stronger
execution: Finishers deal more damage to wounded enemies
sword_wave: Combo finishers launch a travelling blade wave
counterguard: Finishers briefly guard the front; a block empowers the next slash

crosscut: Striking with both axes in succession causes bleed
battle_rhythm: Successful attacks build temporary attack speed
hooked_edges: Outer hits pull smaller enemies inward
whirlwind: Completing a combo spins an attack around you
twin_execution: Periodically strike forward with both axes for focused damage

crowd_pressure: Enemy collisions briefly slow the enemies involved
bowling_blow: Knocked enemies travel farther and damage those they collide with
titans_grip: Replace sweeps with slow overhead crushing blows

aftershock: A weaker second impact strikes the same area
fracture: Repeated hammer hits increase damage from subsequent hammer strikes
seismic_slam: Replace forward waves with circular shockwaves
fissure: Forward waves leave a short-lived damaging crack
